title: Consent review
idea: Consent review: Each requested purpose, data scope and consequence appears before a separately understandable decision.
audience: People who need to review consent within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Consent is optional or granular and needs informed choice.
avoidWhen: One broad acceptance would hide unrelated purposes.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its review consent priority and explicit commitment contract: Persist only explicit permitted consent and expose revocation effects.
navigation: Consent review keeps the current review consent context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Each requested purpose, data scope and consequence appears before a separately understandable decision.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review consent; consent is optional or granular and needs informed choice.
composition.priority: Persist only explicit permitted consent and expose revocation effects.

imagery.role: Support the actual review consent context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use readable purpose sections with equal access to refusal and preference review.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the consent review structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review consent content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Persist only explicit permitted consent and expose revocation effects.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review consent content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Persist only explicit permitted consent and expose revocation effects.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review consent context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
